answer: An agent marketplace selling inlet maps, ivory appraisals, and vine care requires each active seller identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days. A contract escrows payment and slashes the bond if a seller signs two conflicting receipts for the same order, a violation anyone can prove by submitting both signatures. Creating 1,000 fake sellers therefore ties up $100,000, and provable cheating burns the bonds rather than merely sacrificing disposable accounts.
